metadata.title: Watchdog as Entry Point Tasks
metadata.description: Invert the process hierarchy: cardano-watchdog becomes PID 1, spawns Electron via anonymous stdio pipes, generates TLS certs in Rust, removes cardano-launcher, and eliminates the nix/ directory in favour of perSystem/ and flake/lib/.
metadata.importantNote: Standalone watchdog mode (electron section absent from config) must remain fully functional throughout — this is the development and CI mode. The nix/ directory is eliminated entirely; all Nix logic moves to flake/lib/ or perSystem/; non-Nix assets move to packaging/.

phases.name: Rust Core
phases.description: Abstract event emission, add Electron spawn logic, generate TLS certs — all in Rust. No TypeScript or Nix changes yet.

tasks.title: Abstract emit() via OnceLock event channel
tasks.description: Decouple emit() from stdout so events can be routed to Electron's stdin pipe (parent mode) or watchdog's own stdout (standalone mode) without changing any call sites in supervisor.rs or mithril.rs.
implementationNotes: Add: static EVENT_TX: OnceLock<tokio::sync::mpsc::UnboundedSender<String>> = OnceLock::new();
Add: pub fn init_event_sink(tx: UnboundedSender<String>) { EVENT_TX.set(tx).ok(); }
Update emit(): if let Some(tx) = EVENT_TX.get() { let _ = tx.send(line); } else { println!("{line}"); }
Keep STDOUT_GONE AtomicBool guard only in the println! fallback branch
Add event variants: ElectronStarted { pid: u32 }, ElectronExited { code: Option<i32>, signal: Option<String> }
Zero call-site changes to emit() in supervisor.rs or mithril.rs

tasks.title: Add ElectronConfig and spawn Electron in main.rs
tasks.description: Add ElectronConfig to config.rs, make api_port optional. In main.rs: create event channel, init sink, pick free port, spawn Electron with piped stdio, redirect command reader to Electron's stdout, monitor Electron exit.
implementationNotes: config.rs: add ElectronConfig { exe: String, args: Vec<String>, #[serde(default)] env: HashMap<String,String> }
config.rs: WatchdogConfig gains electron: Option<ElectronConfig>
config.rs: WalletConfig api_port: Option<u16> (None = auto-pick at runtime)
config.rs: WatchdogConfig gains pub_logs_dir: Option<String> and tls_dir: Option<String> (CLI overrides)
main.rs: add #[arg(long)] pub_logs_dir: Option<String> and #[arg(long)] tls_dir: Option<String> to Args; merge into config after parsing
main.rs: if api_port is None, bind TcpListener to '127.0.0.1:0', get assigned port, close listener
main.rs: if electron is Some — spawn with stdin: Stdio::piped(), stdout: Stdio::piped(), stderr: log file; call tether_to_watchdog() on child
main.rs: create mpsc::unbounded_channel(); call init_event_sink(tx)
main.rs: drain task — receive from rx, write to child.stdin (detect EPIPE → cmd_tx.send(Stop))
main.rs: replace tokio::io::stdin() command reader with child.stdout reader using same read_bounded_line() logic
main.rs: spawn task: child.wait().await → emit ElectronExited, send Command::Stop
If electron is None: drain rx → tokio::io::stdout(); read commands from tokio::io::stdin() (unchanged standalone behavior)
tether_to_watchdog() already implemented in supervisor.rs — call it on the Electron child process

tasks.title: TLS cert generation in Rust
tasks.description: Add rcgen to Cargo.toml. New module watchdog/src/tls.rs with generate_certs(tls_dir). Called in main.rs before spawning wallet or Electron; cert paths injected into wallet args and Electron env.
implementationNotes: Cargo.toml: add rcgen = '0.13' (pure-Rust, no system OpenSSL); add rustls-pki-types if needed by rcgen API
tls.rs: pub struct TlsPaths { pub ca: PathBuf, pub server_cert: PathBuf, pub server_key: PathBuf, pub client_cert: PathBuf, pub client_key: PathBuf }
tls.rs: pub fn generate_certs(tls_dir: &Path) -> anyhow::Result<TlsPaths>
tls.rs: generate self-signed CA (10-year expiry), server cert signed by CA (1-year), client cert signed by CA (1-year)
tls.rs: write to tls_dir/server/ca.pem, server.pem, server.key; tls_dir/client/client.pem, client.key
tls.rs: skip generation if cert files already exist and are not expired (idempotent across launches)
main.rs: if config.tls_dir is Some, call generate_certs(); inject --tls-ca, --tls-server-cert, --tls-server-key into wallet args; set TLS_CA_CERT, TLS_CLIENT_CERT, TLS_CLIENT_KEY in electron.env
supervisor.rs: wallet spawn adds --port <picked_port> and TLS args from main.rs context (or accept as params)

phases.name: TypeScript Refactor
phases.description: Replace WatchdogManager's spawn-and-pipe with process.stdin/process.stdout. Slim BackendLifecycle and index.ts. Update LauncherConfig type.

tasks.title: Refactor WatchdogManager.ts to use process.stdin/stdout
tasks.description: Remove spawn, config file writing, and proc.stdout wiring. Replace with readline on process.stdin. Send commands via process.stdout.write(). handleEvent() is entirely unchanged.
implementationNotes: start() signature: start(): void (remove exePath and config params)
Remove: spawn(), writeFileSync(configPath, ...), proc.stdout readline wiring, proc.on('exit', ...)
Add: createInterface({ input: process.stdin, crlfDelay: Infinity }); rl.on('line', (line) => { /* same handleEvent() call as today */ })
rl.on('close', () => { /* replaces proc.on('exit') for wallet-ready rejection */ })
sendCommand(): process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(cmd) + '\n') instead of this.proc.stdin.write(...)
stop(): send stop command to process.stdout; resolve when process.stdin closes (watchdog closes our stdin after backends shut down); remove proc.stdin?.end()
handleEvent() — all 130 lines unchanged

tasks.title: Slim BackendLifecycle.ts and update index.ts + config.ts
tasks.description: Remove start() binary-path params, port-picking, arg-building, and TLS cert reading. TLS cert paths now arrive as env vars. Remove binary-path fields from LauncherConfig type.
implementationNotes: BackendLifecycle.ts: start() becomes start(): void (remove watchdogBin, config params)
BackendLifecycle.ts: remove getFreePort() calls, node/wallet arg-building, config object construction
BackendLifecycle.ts: remove TLS cert reading from disk — cert paths now in process.env.TLS_CA_CERT, TLS_CLIENT_CERT, TLS_CLIENT_KEY (set by watchdog before spawning Electron)
BackendLifecycle.ts: remove restart scheduler (watchdog kills Electron via tether; no Electron-side restart needed)
BackendLifecycle.ts: keep event routing to IPC channels, wallet-ready promise wiring, mithril event relay (all unchanged)
index.ts: remove binary-path extraction from launcherConfig; change backendLifecycle.start(watchdogBin, config) → backendLifecycle.start()

config.ts: remove from LauncherConfig type: watchdogBin, nodeBin, walletBin, mithrilBin, snapshotConverterBin, cardanoAddressBin, daedalusBin, updateRunnerBin, updaterArgs, updaterPath, updateArchive, updateWindowsRunner, walletLogging

config.ts: keep: cluster, networkName, stateDir, logsPrefix, launcherLogsPrefix, tlsPath (if referenced by renderer), nodeConfig paths, metadataUrl, smashUrl, isFlight, isStaging, legacyStateDir, legacyWalletDB, legacySecretKey

phases.name: Nix Architecture Migration
phases.description: Eliminate the nix/ directory. All Nix logic moves to perSystem/ or flake/lib/. Non-Nix assets move to packaging/. Generate watchdog-config.json in perSystem/.

tasks.title: Migrate flake/lib/ and flake/nixosModules.nix; split perSystem/packages/
tasks.description: Rename flake/lib.nix → flake/lib/recursive.nix. Create flake/lib/daedalus.nix absorbing common.nix and source-lib.nix. Move launcher-config.nix, cardano-bridge.nix, selfnode-config.nix to flake/lib/. Split perSystem/packages.nix into perSystem/packages/{linux,darwin,windows}.nix.
implementationNotes: flake/lib/recursive.nix: rename current flake/lib.nix; no content change; update any imports that reference flake/lib.nix

flake/lib/daedalus.nix: absorb nix/internal/common.nix and nix/internal/source-lib.nix; export as { inputs, ... }: { lib.daedalus = { installerClusters, buildRev, buildRevShort, buildCounter, mkBinPath, mkPlatformPackages }; }

flake/lib/daedalus.nix: mkPlatformPackages targetSystem returns all of common.nix's current attrs (walletPackages, nodePackages, mithrilPackages, nodejs, yarn, launcherConfigs, daedalus-bridge, cardano-node, cardano-wallet, etc.); remove cardano-launcher and temporaryNodeModulesPatches (cardano-launcher patches) from it

flake/lib/launcher-config.nix: move from nix/internal/launcher-config.nix; slim binary-path and auto-update fields (remove daedalusBin, watchdogBin, nodeBin, walletBin, mithrilBin, snapshotConverterBin, cardanoAddressBin, updateRunnerBin, updaterArgs, updaterPath, updateArchive, updateWindowsRunner, walletLogging, tlsConfig)
flake/lib/cardano-bridge.nix: move from nix/internal/cardano-bridge.nix; update import paths
flake/lib/selfnode-config.nix: move from nix/internal/selfnode-config.nix

perSystem/packages/linux.nix, darwin.nix, windows.nix: split perSystem/packages.nix into platform files; each exports perSystem = { packages = ...; }; flake-parts merges via lib.mkMerge; delete perSystem/packages.nix
nix/internal.nix: delete (self.internal pattern replaced by self.lib.daedalus)
nix/packages.nix: delete (absorbed into perSystem/packages/)
nix/internal/common.nix, source-lib.nix: delete after content moved to flake/lib/daedalus.nix
nix/internal/launcher-config.nix, cardano-bridge.nix, selfnode-config.nix: delete after content moved to flake/lib/

tasks.title: New perSystem/watchdog-config.nix generating per-cluster watchdog-config.json
tasks.description: New perSystem/ file that generates watchdog-config.json per cluster using binary paths from self.lib.daedalus. Runtime-variable fields (pub_logs_dir, tls_dir) are NOT baked in — passed as CLI flags from bin/daedalus.
implementationNotes: New file: perSystem/watchdog-config.nix (auto-discovered by recursiveImports)
lib.mkIf (system == 'x86_64-linux') for Linux-only generation; extend with darwin/windows platform guards in task-008
lib.genAttrs installerClusters (from inputs.self.lib.daedalus.installerClusters) to produce per-cluster configs
Access binaries via platform = inputs.self.lib.daedalus.mkPlatformPackages system
node.exe: platform.cardano-node binary path; node.args: --config, --topology, --socket-path, --database-path, --shutdown-ipc 3 (paths from slimmed launcher-config nodeConfigFiles)
wallet.exe: platform.cardano-wallet binary path; wallet.args: --node-socket, --database, --sync-tolerance; omit --port and --tls-* (watchdog adds at runtime)
electron.exe: platform.electron binary; electron.args: ['--disable-setuid-sandbox', '--no-sandbox']; electron.env: LAUNCHER_CONFIG, CHROME_DEVEL_SANDBOX
mithril: from launcherConfigs.${cluster}.launcherConfig mithril fields
pub_logs_dir and tls_dir: NOT in JSON — passed as --pub-logs-dir and --tls-dir CLI flags by bin/daedalus (see task-008)

tasks.title: Migrate Linux build to perSystem/linux.nix; eliminate nix/internal/x86_64-linux.nix
tasks.description: Inline all of x86_64-linux.nix into perSystem/linux.nix (JS compilation, electron patching, binary assembly, self-extracting archive). Add bin/daedalus generation (execs watchdog). Copy watchdog-config.json into package config dir. Delete x86_64-linux.nix and all remaining nix/internal/ files.
implementationNotes: perSystem/linux.nix: inline daedalusJs, relocatableElectron, newPackage, newBundle, selfExtractingArchive from x86_64-linux.nix; reference helpers from inputs.self.lib.daedalus.mkPlatformPackages 'x86_64-linux'
perSystem/linux.nix: add bin/daedalus script generation using pkgs.writeShellScript; script execs cardano-watchdog --config, --pub-logs-dir, --tls-dir (passes runtime paths as CLI flags)
perSystem/linux.nix: copy watchdog-config.json (from packages.watchdog-config-${cluster}) into $out/config/ alongside launcher-config.yaml
perSystem/linux.nix: remove daedalus-frontend and update-runner script generation (deleted, not migrated)
perSystem/linux.nix: inline nix/tests/shellcheck.nix into perSystem/checks.nix (or delete if covered by existing checks)

packaging/macos/darwin-launcher.go: move from nix/internal/darwin-launcher.go; update exec target from cardano-launcher to cardano-watchdog; update --config arg to watchdog-config.json; runtime paths (pub-logs-dir, tls-dir) computed from DAEDALUS_INSTALL_DIRECTORY in Go
packaging/patches/: move all .patch files from nix/internal/
packaging/runtime-nodejs-deps.json: move from nix/internal/
nix/internal/x86_64-linux.nix: DELETE
nix/internal/darwin-launcher.nix: inline into perSystem/darwin.nix (task-009)
Move linux-self-extracting-archive.sh if not already in packaging/linux/

tasks.title: Migrate macOS and Windows builds to perSystem/darwin.nix + perSystem/windows.nix
tasks.description: New perSystem/darwin.nix inlines any-darwin.nix and darwin-launcher.nix. New perSystem/windows.nix inlines x86_64-windows.nix including NSIS files. Update darwin exec target. Update Windows NSIS shortcut. Delete nix/ directory entirely.
implementationNotes: perSystem/darwin.nix: new file; lib.mkIf (lib.elem system ["x86_64-darwin" "aarch64-darwin"]); inline any-darwin.nix logic; inline darwin-launcher.nix (58 lines, small enough); reference inputs.self.lib.daedalus.mkPlatformPackages for binaries; reference packaging/macos/darwin-launcher.go as source

perSystem/darwin.nix: update darwin-launcher exec target to: cardano-watchdog --config ../Resources/watchdog-config.json; runtime paths (pub-logs-dir, tls-dir) derived from DAEDALUS_INSTALL_DIRECTORY in the Go binary
perSystem/darwin.nix: copy watchdog-config.json into macOS bundle Resources/ alongside launcher-config.yaml
perSystem/windows.nix: new file; lib.mkIf (system == "x86_64-linux") for cross-compilation from Linux; inline x86_64-windows.nix logic; inline nsis*.nix and fastlist.nix (all Nix stays in perSystem/)
perSystem/windows.nix: NSIS shortcut target → cardano-watchdog.exe; remove cardano-launcher.exe from File install list; generate watchdog-config.json into $INSTDIR/
perSystem/windows.nix: reference packaging/runtime-nodejs-deps.json and packaging/patches/ for assets
nix/internal/any-darwin.nix: DELETE after inline
nix/internal/x86_64-windows.nix: DELETE after inline
nix/internal/darwin-launcher.nix: DELETE after inline
nix/ directory: DELETE entirely once all files moved or deleted

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.description: Remove cardano-launcher from all package manifests. Delete manifest file. Verify absence across all bundles.

tasks.title: Remove cardano-launcher from Linux package manifests
tasks.description: Remove cardano-launcher from file manifests, integrity checks, and installed-file lists in deb, rpm, arch, and NixOS packages.
implementationNotes: deb: remove cardano-launcher from file manifests and md5sums in linux-deb-common.sh
rpm: remove from %files section in rpm spec
arch: remove from package() function file list in PKGBUILD
NixOS: remove from activation script and package derivation in perSystem/linux.nix (handled in task-008)
Nix bundle: remove from self-extracting archive contents; update or remove --extract shim

tasks.title: Delete cardano-launcher.exe.manifest and verify complete absence
tasks.description: Delete the Windows manifest file for cardano-launcher. Verify cardano-launcher binary is absent from all platform bundles.
implementationNotes: Delete installers/cardano-launcher.exe.manifest
Verify Linux: ls /opt/daedalus/${cluster}/libexec/cardano-launcher → not found
Verify macOS: ls *.app/Contents/MacOS/cardano-launcher → not found
Verify Windows: check $INSTDIR for cardano-launcher.exe → not found
Verify Nix: grep -r cardano-launcher flake/ perSystem/ packaging/ → only in comments/docs if any

riskAreas: emit() abstraction must maintain zero call-site changes in supervisor.rs and mithril.rs
Standalone mode (electron section absent from config) must remain fully functional for dev/CI
rcgen cert format must exactly match what cardano-wallet expects for TLS mutual auth
Electron stdin/stdout as IPC channel — Electron must not use process.stdin/stdout for anything else
perSystem/watchdog-config.nix binary paths differ between NixOS (Nix store) and native packages (/opt/daedalus/...) — must handle both
flake/lib/daedalus.nix mkPlatformPackages must preserve Windows cross-compilation (x86_64-windows builds on x86_64-linux)
nix/ directory elimination is a large structural change — all import paths referencing nix/ must be updated
darwin-launcher.go test (symlinkJoin with mock cardano-launcher) must be updated to mock cardano-watchdog
summary.testingNotes: cargo test in watchdog/ → yarn compile → treefmt → nix build .#packages.x86_64-linux.daedalus-mainnet → integration smoke test (Linux native pkg) → shutdown test → crash test (kill -9 electron) → TLS test → absence test (no cardano-launcher anywhere) → macOS and Windows smoke flows
summary.rollbackPlan: All changes are on sl/linux-packaging. Rollback: git revert to pre-task-001 state. Watchdog standalone mode is unchanged throughout so intermediate Rust-only states are safe to ship if needed.
